verdict.rationale: Orrick's own Orrick Connect page documents extranets, deal rooms, secure file sharing, and shared client portals and dashboards. It also describes Client Share Rooms that give secure access to deal information, and the same page cites ISO/IEC 27001 certification. missing for 10: explicit documentation of matter-status tracking beyond a mention of 'dashboards', independent or hands-on corroboration of the portal.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm offers a secure client portal or extranet for matters, documents, and status, documented on its own pages

citations.quote: These include extranets and deal rooms, secure content and online file sharing solutions, and shared client portals and dashboards
Client Share Rooms – Dedicated sites for our high-growth tech company clients, these collaborative client portals provide secure access to all relevant information for specific deals
Our systems are certified to the ISO/IEC 27001 Information Security Management Standard
